summary.en-US: Instagram’s Following feed by default. Hide Explore, the Reels feed, and labeled suggestions and ads. Keep posts and profiles.

description.en-US:
Open Instagram and go straight to the native Following feed. Just Following helps you keep up with the people you follow while hiding common distractions.

Choose what to hide from the toolbar popup:
• Explore recommendations, while keeping native account search.
• The dedicated Reels feed, while keeping videos and Reels in Following and on profiles you deliberately open, including accounts you do not follow.
• Labeled suggestions, suggested accounts, sponsored posts, and paid partnerships in Following.
• Stories links and the Stories rail. Stories stay available by default.

Your native posts, profiles, likes, comments, saves, carousels, search, messages, and signed-in account remain available. Your preferences apply automatically and can be reset from the popup.

Privacy: preferences are saved only in this browser. Just Following has no analytics, telemetry, developer-operated backend, or account scraping. It does not collect or transmit your personal data.

Works on Instagram’s website in Firefox 142+ and compatible Zen versions. Designed for Instagram’s English interface. Filtering depends on Instagram’s page structure and visible labels; it is not a network-level ad blocker. Videos and Reels opened directly in a new tab may return to Following when the extension cannot confirm they came from a feed or profile you opened.

Just Following is an independent project and is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

release_notes.en-US: More reliable preference loading: changes made while settings are opening are preserved. Improved consistency between content filtering and video playback, including Story redirects and hidden entry points. Native videos and Reels remain available in Following and on deliberately opened profiles.

version.approval_notes:
Testing requires a signed-in Instagram test account. Follow at least one account with posts to exercise the native Following feed. No credentials are bundled or collected.

1. Open https://www.instagram.com/. The extension redirects to /?variant=following and keeps native post interactions available.
2. Open the toolbar popup. Defaults: hide Explore recommendations, block the Reels feed, and hide suggestions/ads are on; hide Stories is off.
3. Open Search. Native account search remains usable while Explore recommendations are hidden.
4. Open a profile, including an account you do not follow. Native profile posts, videos, and Reels stay available. The dedicated /reels/ feed redirects to Following while blocking is enabled.
5. Toggle each popup preference and check the Instagram tab. Reset restores defaults. Preferences persist in browser.storage.local.
6. Stories remain native by default when Instagram supplies them. Enabling Hide Stories hides their links/rail and redirects direct Story routes to Following.

The extension runs only on instagram.com and www.instagram.com. It uses DOM/CSS filtering and native URL navigation; it does not use private APIs, scrape accounts, collect or transmit personal data, or run remote code. It has no background script or backend. Storage is used only for four boolean preferences. Label-based filtering targets Instagram’s English interface and depends on its current markup. A fresh standalone video/Reel tab may redirect to Following when its source cannot be confirmed.

The ZIP contains the original readable JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SVG icon, manifest, and MIT license. There is no transpilation, minification, or runtime dependency bundle. web-ext packages these files directly; Node development dependencies and store tooling are excluded. Desktop Firefox is the requested compatibility target; Android has not been verified.

Version 0.1.1: shared preference loading and change handling, consolidated DOM filtering, and consistent standalone-video decisions for hiding and playback. Same permissions and extension ID. All 106 automated tests and web-ext lint pass. Live Zen checks cover desktop/mobile navigation, account search, Explore filtering, suggested accounts, profile Reel playback, and reversible highlight settings. No extension-source console errors observed. Sponsored feed posts and the Stories rail were not supplied in that session and were not live-verified.
